POL-02.text: Branches shall verify the identity of every customer using documents or data from a reliable source before onboarding is complete.
For corporate customers the UBO register is captured and the ownership structure is recorded at onboarding.
Customer records are refreshed periodically according to the risk tier assigned at onboarding.

POL-01.text: Alerts are investigated and suspicious activity is reported to the relevant authority promptly.
Customer relationships are monitored on an ongoing basis and transactions that are complex or unusual are reviewed.

POL-06.text: The firm identifies its important business services and sets an impact tolerance for each service.
Business continuity plans are reviewed annually and approved by the Board.

POL-09.text: Primary payment data of Indian customers is stored in India; copies may be held in regional disaster recovery sites.
Any cross-border transfer of personal information requires a documented transfer assessment and prior approval from the Privacy Office.

POL-05.text: Material outsourcing arrangements are risk tiered and subject to due diligence before contract signature.
Exit plans are documented for critical service providers.

POL-08.text: Personal data breaches are assessed and notified to the supervisory authority without undue delay.
